window-2.title: Cool but not “cool cool” — Kiko Mizuhara on Blackbird Spyplane
window-2.blurb: Spyplane at its goofiest and most obsessive, interviewing a Tokyo shapeshifter who acts, models, and designs — basically your side-quest energy in interview form.

window-3.title: Sparkling Hibiscus Sangria Mocktail
window-3.blurb: It's a whole magenta pitcher of hibiscus and floating fruit — basically built to be batched for your people, photographed on 35mm, and refilled twice before anyone notices there's no booze in it.

window-4.title: Barcelona Remodel by Conti Cert: '70s Style Redux
window-4.blurb: You already know how to commit to a persona, so here's a whole apartment doing it — '70s Barcelona reworked with real warmth instead of costume-y nostalgia, and about five ideas in here you could steal for one corner of your place this weekend.

window-5.title: MOZmoji 陌迹, Chinatown
window-5.blurb: You climb a staircase off Temple Street into a shophouse ceramics gallery where you get to pick your own handmade cup — each one modelled after a season or festival in the Chinese calendar — and then just sit there with cotton cheesecake and black sesame coffee like you live there.
